يسللن (form I)
# يَسْلُلْنَ (yaslulna) /jas.lul.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of سَلَّ (salla)
# يُسْلَلْنَ (yuslalna) /jus.lal.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of سَلَّ (salla) and سُلَّ (sulla)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
